title: Service and Purpose
subtitle: For the life that needs a task worthy of its breath
description: These readings take purpose out of self-concern and put it back into service that leaves the room lighter than it found it.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Purpose becomes believable when it spends itself on what is near instead of feeding the self.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Before the next task starts enlarging your importance, relieve one real need in front of you.
